title: Settings
subtitle: Trading mode, risk parameters, and system health
strategyFirstDesc: Rule-based strategies (DCA, Grid, EMA, etc.) generate trade signals. AI analyzes market conditions and provides context on the dashboard — it does NOT execute trades.
strategyFlow: Strategy generates signal → AI filter reviews news/events → Risk manager checks regime/drawdown → Trade opens
autoSwitchDesc: Allow AI to switch strategies based on market regime
autoSwitchNote: Cooldown 1h between switches, max 3/day. Respects rollout mode (shadow/paper = log only).
modeShadowDesc: Agent runs, decisions logged only — no trades executed
modePaperDesc: Simulated account — fake tickets, no real money
modeMicroDesc: Real execution capped at 0.01 lot — minimal risk
modeLiveDesc: Full autonomous trading at target risk levels
switchToLiveDesc: This will enable full autonomous trading with real money at target risk levels. Make sure all readiness checks pass.
noActiveSymbols: No active symbols — start the bot to configure per-symbol settings.
